source_constraints: validate uses sys.argv --config_path to infer checkpoint, not only a decoded configuration field.
--policy.path takes priority over the resume branch and must not be included in the registered resume CLI.
A copied config in a new recovery directory cannot be passed as config_path without an independently tested checkpoint-path override.
resume=true skips the installed existing-output rejection; the new wrapper must independently require output path absent.
scope: Decoded saved configs, changed resume/output in memory, called installed validate with original checkpoint config_path; not full CLI parser or trainer execution.
